text:
jess: noticed a weird parity issue after today's deploy — Node SDK returns 1536-length embedding but REST/python show 512. Only reproducible when KV cache is ON and we batch 3 docs.

deploy-bot: deploy-1150 finished canary -> prod :rocket:

omar: can you paste a tiny repro and SDK/version? sounds like concat on retry.

jess: node SDK 1.4.3, node v18. Batch_size=3, model=open-vect-512. Minimal: call embeddings.create with three inputs; check r.data[0].embedding.length.

li: any auth refreshes in the trace?

jess: yes, first attempt 401 then token refresh + retry. Server returns three 512 vectors on retry but node returns one 1536 vector. python SDK not affected.

omar: likely the batch accumulator isn't being reset on retry when cache prefix exists. @sdk-team can you look?

sdk-team: got it. please attach the request ids / raw response bodies. we'll add a unit to simulate cached prefix + auth retry.

jess: attached small trace gist. Workaround: set disable_auto_retry=true or batch_size=1 — both avoid the bug.

omar: creating ticket INF-6790 to track. P1. plan hotfix tomorrow and add parity tests.

sdk-team: thanks — will prioritize Node patch and check Python replication path.

jess: leaving disable_auto_retry on in staging until fixed. :thumbsup:
